text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With more teammates, Twin Turbo overcame 
her "timidity." However, she continues to 
suffer a losing streak in mock races. 
Meanwhile—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio's debut is also somewhat 
delayed. Dark clouds hang over her Classic 
Triple Crown run, but... she continues to 
work hard without giving up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo is inspired by that attitude. 
And once again, a fire is lit within her 
heart.
